name: Paul Gerard
office: Burbank Unified School District, Governing Board Member, Trustee Area No. 3

items.text: Paul Gerard is a professor of animation for the Peter Stark Program at the University of Southern California and a former executive at The Walt Disney Co., Hasbro, and Warner Bros. He is running for Trustee Area No. 3 on the Burbank Unified School District board, with a campaign centered on restoring fiscal stability to a district that independent auditors gave a "Lack of Going Concern" designation.

sentences.text: Paul Gerard is a professor of animation for the Peter Stark Program at the University of Southern California and a former executive at The Walt Disney Co., Hasbro, and Warner Bros.

He is running for Trustee Area No. 3 on the Burbank Unified School District board, with a campaign centered on restoring fiscal stability to a district that independent auditors gave a "Lack of Going Concern" designation.

items.text: He has proposed working with district leadership to restructure BUSD’s finances, strengthen internal controls, and restore multi-year budget discipline to keep schools under local control. His campaign website states he will prioritize transparency, fiscal stability, enrollment and student representation.
